dv.title: ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާއި ބުރުންޑީއާއި ދެމެދު ވިސާ ވެއިވަރ އެއްބަސްވުމުގައި ސޮއިކޮށްފި
dv.description: ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ސަރުކާރާއި ބުރުންޑީ ސަރުކާރާއި ދެމެދު ވިސާ ވެއިވަރ އެއްބަސްވުމުގައި ސޮއިކޮށްފިއެވެ.
dv.body:
ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ސަރުކާރާއި ބުރުންޑީ ސަރުކާރާއި ދެމެދު ވިސާ ވެއިވަރ އެއްބަސްވުމުގައި ސޮއިކޮށްފިއެވެ.

'އެގްރިމެންޓް އޮން މިއުޗުއަލް އެގްޒެމްޝަން އޮފް ވިސާ ރިކުއަޔަރމަންޓްސް"ގެ ދަށުން، ވިސާއާ ނުލައި ދިވެހިންނަށް ބުރުންޑީއަށް 30 ދުވަހުގެ މުއްދަތަކަށް އެތެރެވެވޭނެއެވެ. އަދި ހަމަ އެފަދައިން ބުރުންޑީގެ ރައްޔިތުނަށްންވެސް ވިސާނެގުމެއްނެތި 30 ދުވަހުގެ މުއްދަތަކަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއަށް ދަތުރުކުރެވޭނެއެވެ. އަދި ޓްރާންސިޓްކުރުމުގައިވެސް މި އެއްބަސްވުމުގެ ދަށުން ވިސާ ނަގާކަށް ނުޖެހޭނެއެވެ.

މިއަދު ނިއުޔޯކުގައި ހުންނަ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ދާއިމީ މިޝަނުގައި ބޭއްވި ރަސްމިއްޔާތެއްގައި، މި އެއްބަސްވުމުގައި ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރުގެ ފަރާތުން ސޮއިކުރެއްވީ، އ.ދ. އަށް ކަނޑައަޅުއްވާފައި ހުންނަވާ ދާއިމީ މަންދޫބު އަލްފާޟިލާ ތިލްމީޒާ ހުސައިން އެވެ. ބުރުންޑީ ސަރުކާރުގެ ފަރާތުން ސޮއިކުރެއްވީ އ.ދ. އަށް ކަނޑައަޅުއްވާފައި ހުންނަވާ އެ ގައުމުގެ ދާއިމީ މަންދޫބު ހިޒް އެކްސަލަންސީ ޒެފްރިން މަނިރަތަންގަ އެވެ.

މި އެއްބަސްވުމުގައި ސޮއިކުރުމުގެ ރަސްމިއްޔާތުގައި ވާހަކަފުޅު ދައްކަވަމުން ދާއިމީ މަންދޫބު ތިލްމީޒާ ވިދާޅުވީ، ދެޤައުމުގެ ގުޅުން އިތުރަށް ހަރުދަނާކުރުމަށް ބުރުންޑީ ސަރުކާރުން ދެއްވާ އެއްބާރުލުމަށް ޝުކުރު އަދާކުރައްވާކަމަށާއި މިއަދު ސޮއިކުރެވުނު ވިސާ ވެއިވަރ އެގްރިމެންޓްއާއެކު ދެ ޤައުމުގެ ރައްޔިތުން އެއް ޤައުމުން އަނެއް ޤައުމަށް ފަސޭހަކަމާކާއެކު ދަތުރުކޮށް، ދެ ޤައުމުގެ ގުޅުން އިތުރަށް ހަރުދަނާވެގެންދާނެ ކަމަށެވެ.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Union Day greetings to Tanzania
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Union Day greetings to Tanzania
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Union Day greetings to Tanzania

Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to Her Excellency Dr. Stergomena Lawrence Tax, Minister for Foreign Affairs and East African Cooperation of the United Republic of Tanzania on the occasion of Tanzania’s Union Day.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It is my pleasure to extend greetings and good wishes to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Tanzania on the joyous occasion of Union Day of the Republic of Tanzania It is my sincere hope that the cordial relations existing between our two countries will further strengthen in the years ahead.

Please accept, Excellency, my best wishes for your good health and happiness, and for the continued peace, progress and prosperity of the people of Tanzania

en.title: Maldives and Burundi Sign a Visa Waiver Agreement
en.description: The Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Republic of Burundi signed the Agreement on Mutual Exemption of Visa Requirements today
en.body:
The Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Republic of Burundi signed the Agreement on Mutual Exemption of Visa Requirements today

The Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Republic of Burundi today signed the Agreement on Mutual Exemption of Visa Requirements, which allows for the exemption of visas for single or multiple entry, exit or transit for both countries' nationals, for a period of 30 days.

The agreement was signed on behalf of the Government of Maldives by Her Excellency Thilmeeza Hussain, Permanent Representative of the Maldives to the United Nations, and on behalf of the Government of Burundi by His Excellency Zéphyrin Maniratanga, Permanent Representative of Burundi to the United Nations. The signing ceremony was held in New York, at the Permanent Mission of the Republic of Maldives to the United Nations.

During the discussions at the signing ceremony, Permanent Representative Thilmeeza thanked the Government of Burundi for its commitment towards strengthening the existing bilateral relations between the two countries and conveyed hope that the signing of this agreement will increase avenues for engagement and people to people contact between the Maldives and Burundi. The Permanent Representative of Burundi also expressed keen interest in strengthening the bilateral ties with the Maldives.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Zimbabwe
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Zimbabwe
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Zimbabwe

Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid has sent a message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Trade of the Republic of Zimbabwe, Frederick Makamure Shava, on the occasion of Zimbabwe's Independence Day.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It is my pleasure to extend warm felicitations and best wishes to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Zimbabwe on the joyous occasion of your Independence Day.

It is my earnest hope that the bilateral partnership between our two countries will continue to thrive in the years ahead.

Let me also convey, Excellency, my personal best wishes for your good health and well-being and for continued progress and prosperity for the people of Zimbabwe.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Statement by the Government of Maldives expressing its support to the continuous efforts of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to reach a comprehensive political solution to end the crisis in Yemen
en.description: Statement by the Government of Maldives expressing its support to the continuous efforts of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to reach a comprehensive political solution to end the crisis in Yemen
en.body:
Statement by the Government of Maldives expressing its support to the continuous efforts of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to reach a comprehensive political solution to end the crisis in Yemen

The Government of Maldives expresses its strong support to the continuous efforts of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to reach a comprehensive political solution to end the crisis in Yemen.

Government of Maldives especially welcomes the recent meetings held in Sanaa during the period 8 to 13 April, 2023 by the Saudi delegation, headed by His Excellency Mohammad Al Jabir, the Ambassador of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques to Yemen, building upon the Saudi Initiative announced in March 2021, and the positive momentum created by the humanitarian truce in Yemen since its announcement by the United Nations in April 2022.

The Government of Maldives calls on all Yemeni parties (the legitimate government and the Houthis) to respond positively to these efforts to achieve the aspirations of the Yemeni people for development, prosperity, peace and stability in Yemen.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Syria
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Syria
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Syria

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid has sent a message of felicitations to the Minister for Foreign Affairs and Expatriates of the Syrian Arab Republic, His Excellency Fayssal Mekdad, on the occasion of the Independence Day of Syria.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It gives me great pleasure to extend sincere greetings and felicitations to Your Excellency, the Government, and the brotherly people of the Syrian Arab Republic on the occasion of the Independence Day of Syria.

I am confident that the close relations and the bonds of friendship between our two countries, will continue to prosper in the years ahead.

I also take this opportunity to convey my personal well wishes and prayers for Your Excellency’s good health and well-being and for the continued progress and prosperity of Syria.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Congratulatory Message to the New Foreign Minister of Nepal
en.description: Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid has sent a congratulatory message to Narayan Prakash Saud, the new Minister of Foreign Affairs of Nepal
en.body:
Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid has sent a congratulatory message to Narayan Prakash Saud, the new Minister of Foreign Affairs of Nepal

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid has sent a congratulatory message to Narayan Prakash Saud on his appointment as the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Nepal.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

"It is my pleasure to convey my heartfelt congratulations on Your Excellency’s appointment as the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Nepal.

The Maldives and Nepal have always had warm and cordial relations based on mutual respect and trust. I am confident that the friendly relations and cooperation that exist between our two countries will be further strengthened during your term of office. Let me express my eagerness to collaborate closely with you on bilateral and international levels for the mutual benefit of our two nations and peoples.

I am looking forward to meeting with you and discussing how we can further strengthen our bilateral cooperation and friendship. Please accept my sincerest wishes for Your Excellency's health and well-being, as well as for the sustained development and prosperity of the Nepalese people.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration."

en.title: Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Russia presents Credentials to the Russian Federation
en.description: Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Russia presents Credentials to the Russian Federation
en.body:
Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Russia presents Credentials to the Russian Federation

Ambassador of the Republic of Maldives to the Federal Republic of Germany Her Excellency Aishath Shaan Shakir has presented her Letter of Credence, as the Non-Resident Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the Republic of Maldives to the Russian Federation, at a ceremony held at the Embassy of Russia in Berlin today.

His Excellency Sergey Nechayev, Ambassador of Russia to Germany received the Letter of Credence issued by President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, addressed to His Excellency Vladimir Putin, President of Russia, under a special arrangement made by the Government of Russia.

During the meeting that followed the Credential Ceremony, Ambassador Nechayev welcomed Ambassador Shaan and wished her success in undertaking her duties. Ambassador Shaan expressed her gratitude and conveyed personal greetings and warm felicitations from President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih to the President, the Government, and the people of Russia. She also expressed her commitment to enhancing existing bilateral relations and close cooperation between the two countries.

Ambassador Shaan was accompanied by Mr. Mohamed Fazeel Hussain, Counsellor at the Embassy of Maldives in the Federal Republic of Germany.

en.title: Minister of Foreign Affairs meets the President and members of the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives
en.description: Minister of Foreign Affairs meets the President and members of the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives
en.body:
Minister of Foreign Affairs meets the President and members of the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives

Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid met with the President and the Members of the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives today.

During the meeting held this morning at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, President of the Human Rights Commission Mariyam Muna briefed Minister Shahid on the work undertaken by the Commission over the past three years to improve the human rights situation in the Maldives. Both sides discussed the importance of promoting and protecting human rights at home and agreed to work closely together to effectively address shared interests and goals internationally. Minister Shahid also reaffirmed the Government’s commitment to the values of human rights and democracy.

Minister Shahid was accompanied by Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Ahmed Khaleel, Joint Secretary Mariyam Midhfa Naeem, and Chief General Service Officer Mizna Waheed. The President of the Human Rights Commission was accompanied by Vice President Dr. Ahmed Adham Abdulla, and Commissioners Aminath Shifaath Abdul Razzaq, Moomina Waheed, and Samaau Ahmed Najeeb, and Secretary General of the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives Aminath Naushan Abdul Muhaimin.

Constituted under Chapter 7 of the Constitution of the Maldives 2008, the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives is the first independent and autonomous statutory body in the Maldives. The Human Rights Commission of the Maldives aims to champion human rights by promoting and protecting dignity, diversity and equality within the Maldives.

dv.title: މާތްވެގެންވާ ރަމަޟާން މަހު އަލް-އަޤްސާ މިސްކިތުގައި އަޅުކަންކުރަމުންދާ ފަރާތްތަކަށް އިސްރާއީލުން މެދުކެނޑުމެއްނެތި ކުރަމުންދާ އަނިޔާތަކާ ގުޅޭގޮތުން މަޝްވަރާކުރުމަށްޓަކައި މިއަދު ބޭއްވި އޯ.އައި.ސީ. ގެ އެގްޒެކެޓިވް ކޮމިޓީގެ އޯޕަން- އެންޑެޑް ކުއްލި ބައްދަލުވ
dv.description: އަންގާރަ ދުވަހުގެ ރޭ އިސްރާއީލުގެ ސިފައިން އަލްއަގްސާ މިސްކިތަށް ވަދެ، އެތަނުގައި އަޅުކަންކުރަމުން ދިޔަ ފަލަސްތީނުގެ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ދިން ހަމަލާއާއި، މި މާތްވެގެންވާ ރަމަޟާން މަހު އަޅުކަންކުރާ ފަރާތްތަކަށް އަނިޔާވެ،…
dv.body:
އަންގާރަ ދުވަހުގެ ރޭ އިސްރާއީލުގެ ސިފައިން އަލްއަގްސާ މިސްކިތަށް ވަދެ، އެތަނުގައި އަޅުކަންކުރަމުން ދިޔަ ފަލަސްތީނުގެ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ދިން ހަމަލާއާއި، މި މާތްވެގެންވާ ރަމަޟާން މަހު އަޅުކަންކުރާ ފަރާތްތަކަށް އަނިޔާވެ، އަލް-އަޤްސާ މިސްކިތަށް ގެއްލުންދިނުމާއި، އަދި އަލް-އަޤްސާ މިސްކިތަށް އިސްރާއީލުން މެދުނުކެނޑި ދެމުންގެންދާ އުދުވާނީ އަމަލުތަކާއި ގުޅޭގޮތުން މަޝްވަރާކުރުމަށްޓަކައި އޯ.އައި.ސީ.ގެ މައި މަރުކަޒުގައި މިއަދު ބޭއްވި އެ ޖަމުއިއްޔާގެ އެގްޒެކެޓިވް ކޮމިޓީގެ އޯޕަން-އެންޑެޑް ކުއްލި ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ފަރާތުން އޯ.އައި.ސީ. އަށް ކަނޑައަޅުއްވާފައި ހުންނަވާ ދާއިމީ މަންދޫބު އަދި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ފަރާތުން ސައުދީ އަރަބިއްޔާއަށް ކަނޑައަޅުއްވާފައި ހުންނަވާ ސަފީރު އަލްފާޟިލް މުޙައްމަދު ޚަލީލް ބައިވެރިވެ ވަޑައިގަތެވެ.

އަދި މިބައްދަލުވުމުގައި އޯ.އައި.ސީ. ގެ މެންބަރު ޤައުމުތަކުން ވަނީ އެ ޢަމަލުތައް ހަރުކަށި އިބާރާތުން ކުށްވެރިކޮށް، ފަލަސްތީނުގެ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ދެމުންގެންދާ އެހީތެރިކަމާއި އެއްބާރުލުން އިތުރުކޮށްދިނުމަށް އެދި، މި މައްސަލައާ ގުޅޭ ޤަރާރެއް ފާސްކޮށްފައެވެ.

ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއިން އަބަދުވެސް ގޮވާލަމުންދަނީ ފަލަސްތީނުގެ ބިންތަކަށް އިސްރާއީލުން ވެރިވެގަތުން ނިމުމަކަށް ގެނެސް، ފަލަސްތީނުގެ މިނިވަން ދައުލަތެއް ޤާއިމްކޮށް، 1967 ވަނަ އަހަރުގެ ކުރީގެ ބޯޑަރާ ހިސާބަށް އިސްރާއީލުން ފަހަތަށް ޖެހުމަށް ބާރުއަޅާ، ފަލަސްތީނުގެ ދައުލަތުގެ ވެރިރަށުގެ ގޮތުގައި އިރުމަތީ ޤުދުސް އޮންނަން ޖެހޭ ކަމަށެވެ.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends a message of felicitation to the Director-General of the World Health Organization (WHO), Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, on the occasion 75th anniversary of the World Health Organisation
en.description: Minister Shahid sends a message of felicitation
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends a message of felicitation

The Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It is with much pleasure I extend to you, Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, warm greetings and best wishes on behalf of the Government and people of Maldives, on the occasion of this year’s World Health Day, which also marks the 75th anniversary of World Health Organization (WHO).

This milestone presents us with another opportunity to reflect on the achievements and progress we have made in the past 7 decades. It gives us the chance to boost investment towards addressing the core global health challenges. It also gives us the opportunity to weigh up on what more we can do to realize our vision and make access to quality health care a reality for all.

The Maldives has enjoyed a long, fruitful and prosperous relationship with the WHO. WHO was the first UN agency to open an office in the Maldives in February 1965, having been active in the country even prior to independence. Our close partnership over the past five decades has enabled Maldives to achieve great strides in health outcomes, and a healthy society. We are immensely grateful for the support provided by WHO over the years. More recently, WHO support in tackling the COVID-19 pandemic was invaluable, including in strengthening our national health system, and mobilizing resources for future pandemic preparedness.

I also wish to take this opportunity to convey my personal good wishes for your health and well-being, and for the success of WHO’s journey to achieve Health For All.

Please accept, Director General, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Maldives Delegation actively participated in the 52nd Session of the Human Rights Council
en.description: Maldives Delegation actively participated in the 52nd Session of the Human Rights Counci
en.body:
Maldives Delegation actively participated in the 52nd Session of the Human Rights Counci

The 52nd Session of the United Nations Human Rights Council concluded in Geneva yesterday.

The Human Rights Council adopted 43 resolutions, extending 19 thematic and country-specific mandates, and appointed 10 Special Procedure mandate holders.

The Minister of Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Mr. Abdulla Shahid participated in the High Level Segment of the 52nd Session of the Human Rights Council and addressed the council on 27 February 2023. In his statement, he highlighted the progress made by the government of President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih in the promotion and protection of human rights. Minister Shahid also participated in two high level side events and conducted bilateral meetings with several of his counterparts.

The Delegation of Maldives delivered 29 national statements on an array of thematic areas of the Human Rights Council. The Maldives co-sponsored 19 resolutions, including mandate renewal for Special Rapporteur on minority issues, Special Rapporteur on the promotion and protection of the right to freedom of opinion and expression, Special Rapporteur on human rights defenders. Maldives also co-sponsored thematic resolutions on the right to food, efficient public services delivery, democracy and the rule of law, among others.

The Maldives was part of the cross-regional core group that drafted a thematic resolution on the human right to a clean, healthy, and sustainable environment. The main objective of this resolution is to request the Special Rapporteur to convene a one-day expert seminar on the responsibility of business enterprises to respect the human right to a clean, healthy and sustainable environment, before the end of 2023. This resolution was adopted by consensus and had more than 60 co-sponsors supporting the resolution at the time of adoption.

The Maldives also co-sponsored 33 joint statements delivered at the Council. This included statements by the Organization for Islamic Cooperation and the Non-Aligned Movement, among others. The Maldives on behalf of the group of Small Island Developing States (SIDS) delivered a statement at the High-Level Panel Discussion on Voluntary Funds for UPR and urged member states to continue supporting the UPR Voluntary Funds to promote the involvement of SIDS in the UPR process. In addition, Maldives co-sponsored five side events on the areas of combating torture, gender and climate change, innovative solutions to the challenges faced by SIDS, Special Rapporteur on Human rights and Environment’s report women and girls and the right to a clean, healthy and sustainable environment, and centering victims in state-led investigations of human rights violations.

The Maldives Delegation at the 52nd Session of the UN Human Rights Council was led by H.E. Dr. Asim Ahmed, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary and Permanent Representative of the Maldives to the United Nations Office at Geneva. As the Vice President of the Council, representing the Asia Pacific Group, Dr. Asim Ahmed chaired several meetings of the Council.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Congratulatory Message to the New Foreign Minister of Kazakhstan
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Congratulatory Message to the New Foreign Minister of Kazakhstan
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Congratulatory Message to the New Foreign Minister of Kazakhstan

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid has sent a congratulatory message to His Excellency Nurtleu Murat, Deputy Prime Minister and the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan on his appointment.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It is my pleasure to convey warm congratulations on Your Excellency’s appointment as the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

The Maldives and Kazakhstan have always enjoyed warm and friendly relations based on mutual respect and trust. I am confident that the friendly relations and cooperation that exist between our two countries will be further strengthened during your term of office.

I look forward to working closely with Your Excellency, and the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan in further enhancing our close bilateral relations, and in achieving our shared interests and objectives.

Let me also convey my best wishes for Your Excellency’s good health and well-being, as well as for the continued progress and prosperity of the people of Kazakhstan. Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration”.

en.title: Presidential Envoy and Advisor to the President of Sri Lanka pays a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.description: Presidential Envoy and Advisor to the President of Sri Lanka pays a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.body:
Presidential Envoy and Advisor to the President of Sri Lanka pays a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs

The Presidential Envoy and Advisor to the President of Sri Lanka, Honorable Niranjan Deva Aditya paid a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid, today.

During the meeting held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs this morning, Minister Shahid welcomed the Presidential Envoy to the Maldives and reflected on the long history of bilateral relations and the strong people to people ties between the Maldives and Sri Lanka. The Minister highlighted that Maldives and Sri Lanka have been crucial to each other’s development in the past and will continue to support Sri Lanka in their efforts for economic revitalization.

Minister Shahid and the Presidential Envoy reiterated the commitment of both Governments to continue working closely together, bilaterally and in the international fora, on issues of shared importance.

Minister Shahid was accompanied to the Meeting by Foreign Secretary, Ahmed Latheef, Secretary-Economic Cooperation, Dr. Hussain Niyaz, Secretary-Bilateral, Dr. Hala Hameed, Additional Secretary, Mohamed Faisal and Director, Moomina Ibrahim.

The Presidential Envoy and Advisor to the President of Sri Lanka is presently undertaking an official visit to the Maldives from 04 - 08 April 2023.

en.title: Statement by the Government of Maldives condemning the storming of the Al-Aqsa Mosque by Israeli Forces
en.description: Statement by the Government of Maldives
en.body:
Statement by the Government of Maldives

The Government of Maldives strongly condemns the storming of the Al-Aqsa Mosque by Israeli forces on Tuesday night, and the attack on Palestinian worshipers, causing injury to worshipers and destruction to the mosque during this holy month of Ramadan.

These actions by the Israeli forces are a blatant violation of international law and relevant resolutions of the United Nations Security Council and the United Nations General Assembly. Such actions undermine efforts to achieve a lasting resolution to the conflict and the efforts to achieve peace and stability in the region.

The Government and the people of Maldives stand in solidarity with the people of Palestine and assure firm support for their legitimate and just struggle to achieve a free, independent and sovereign State of Palestine. The Maldives reiterates its steadfast commitment to work closely with the international community to advocate for the cause of the Palestinians.

A lasting, peaceful resolution of the conflict can only be realized through a two-state solution, with an independent and sovereign State of Palestine, based on the pre 1967 borders, with East Jerusalem as its capital.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Senegal
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Senegal
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Senegal

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid has sent a message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Senegalese Abroad of the Republic of Senegal, Mariam Aïssata Tall Sall, on the occasion of the Independence Day of Senegal.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It is my pleasure to extend warm felicitations and best wishes, to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of Senegal on the occasion of your Independence Day. It is my earnest hope that the ties of friendship between our two countries will continue to flourish.

Let me also convey, Excellency, my personal best wishes for your good health and well-being, and for further progress of the people of Senegal.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Japan and Maldives Holds 4th Round of Policy Dialogue
en.description: Japan and Maldives Holds 4th Round of Policy Dialogue
en.body:
Japan and Maldives Holds 4th Round of Policy Dialogue

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan has successfully concluded the 4th Round of Japan-Maldives Policy Dialogue, which was held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan today.

The Maldivian delegation was led by His Excellency Mr. Ahmed Khaleel, Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, and the Japanese Delegation was led by Mr. Arima Yutaka, Director-General, Southeast and Southwest Asian Department. The discussion throughout the dialogue were very productive, drawing upon the solid foundation established during the preceding three rounds of the policy dialogue.

The Dialogue focused on enhancing the already close relations between the two countries, especially through economic and development cooperation, in trade and investment, cultural exchanges, and in regional and maritime cooperation.

Key areas of focus during the dialogue included:

Economic Cooperation: Both nations expressed their commitment to working closely together in order to foster mutual growth and development. The dialogue featured discussions on potential avenues for collaboration, aiming to create a prosperous future for both countries through joint efforts and initiatives.

Regional and International Issues: The two countries addressed pressing regional and global concerns, emphasizing the importance of maintaining peace, stability, and prosperity in the region. Maldives and Japan also explored opportunities for joint initiatives and partnerships to tackle these challenges, including in a free and open Indian Ocean region.

People-to-People Exchanges: The dialogue emphasized the importance of cultural exchange and educational cooperation, recognizing that these interactions deepen mutual understanding and strengthen the bond between the two nations. Both parties agreed to promote and support more frequent engagements in the fields of arts, culture, sports, and education, furthering the growth of their relationship.

The fourth round of the Maldives-Japan Policy Dialogue demonstrated the commitment of both nations to further enhance their bilateral relations and work together to address shared challenges.

The Policy Dialogue is a platform between Maldives and Japan to discuss important bilateral, regional and multilateral issues. The last Policy Dialogue was held in virtually on 4 March 2021.

en.title: Foreign Secretary meets the Vice Chairman of China International Development Cooperation Agency (CIDCA)
en.description: Foreign Secretary meets the Vice Chairman of China International Development Cooperation Agency (CIDCA)
en.body:
Foreign Secretary meets the Vice Chairman of China International Development Cooperation Agency (CIDCA)

The Vice Chairman of the China International Development Cooperation Agency (CIDCA) His Excellency Deng Boqing met with the Foreign Secretary of the Republic of Maldives, His Excellency Ahmed Latheef, today at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

During the meeting, both sides discussed the importance of the Global Development Initiatives proposed by China, and ways to further strengthen the bilateral relation between the two countries, as well as the ongoing projects by China in Maldives.

Foreign Secretary Latheef thanked Vice Chairman Deng Boqing and the Chinese Government, for the generous assistance it had provided to the Maldives. Foreign Secretary Latheef also agreed to work closely together to address shared interests, in further enhancing the close relations between the two countries.

Vice Chaiman Deng Boqing is presently undertaking an official visit to the Maldives from 31 March to 3 April 2023.

en.title: Vice-Chairman of China International Development Cooperation Agency (CIDCA) pays a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.description: Vice-Chairman of China International Development Cooperation Agency (CIDCA) pays a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.body:
Vice-Chairman of China International Development Cooperation Agency (CIDCA) pays a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs

The Vice Chairman of the China International Development Cooperation Agency (CIDCA), His Excellency Deng Boqing paid a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid, Order of the Distinguished Rule of Izzuddin, today.

During the meeting held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs this morning, the Minister thanked the Vice-Chairman and the Government of the People’s Republic of China for their valuable contributions towards the socio-economic development of the Maldives. He mentioned that China continues to be a major investor in the Maldivian economy, through the various projects that are ongoing in the country, and also as a source market for inbound tourism.

The Vice-Chairman briefed the Minister about the ongoing projects and future avenues of cooperation, especially through China’s Global Development Initiative (GDI). He outlined that the signing of the agreements today between the two sides, signifies the close friendship and cooperation, and expressed his hope that the Maldives will seek future development opportunities through the GDI.

The Minister emphasised the importance of commencing new projects by CIDCA in the Maldives, especially the construction of four new hospitals in Ha. Dhidhoo, Dh. Kudahuvadhoo, Ga. Villingili and R. Alifushi. He also thanked the Vice-Chairman for positively considering the projects relating to the renovation of the Maldives National Museum and the maintenance of the China-Maldives Friendship Bridge, for which Letters of Exchange will be signed today.

The Minister underlined that the bilateral relationship between Maldives and China will continue to strengthen in the years ahead, and thanked China for its unwavering support to the Maldives in achieving its developmental objectives.

The Vice-Chairman of CIDCA is on an official visit to the Maldives from 31 March to 3 April 2023.

en.title: Maldives and China Sign Key Agreements During Official Visit
en.description: Maldives and China Sign Key Agreements During Official Visit
en.body:
Maldives and China Sign Key Agreements During Official Visit

Minister of Foreign Affairs His Excellency Abdulla Shahid and the Ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to the Republic of Maldives Her Excellency Wang Lixin, today witnessed the signing of key agreements on important areas such as infrastructure development and health.

The agreements were signed during the ongoing visit of His Excellency Deng Boqing, Vice Chairman of the Chinese International Development Cooperation Agency (CIDCA) to the Maldives. The agreements that were signed today include “Memorandum of Understanding Between China International Development Cooperation Agency of the Government of the People’s Republic of China and Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives on Development Cooperation Plan (2023-2025)”, which will focus on promoting cooperation in such areas as health care, climate change, infrastructure, agriculture, people-to-people exchanges and disaster prevention and reduction, promote economic and social development and improve people's lives and livelihood in the Maldives. The agreement was signed by Foreign Secretary His Excellency Ahmed Latheef on behalf of the Government of Maldives.

His Excellency Ahmed Adil, Minister of State for Health signed on behalf of the Government, the “Letters of Exchange on the Feasibility Study on Hospitals in Maldives”. His Excellency Mohamed Thoriq, Minister of State for Arts, Culture and Heritage signed on behalf of the Government, the “Letters of Exchange on Renovation of the Maldives National Museum”. His Excellency Akram Kamaaluddin, Minister of State for National Planning and Infrastructure signed on behalf of the Government, the “Letters of Exchange on the Maintenance of the China-Maldives Friendship Bridge”.

Speaking at the Signing Ceremony that was held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Minister Shahid reiterated the close relations the Maldives presently enjoys with China and thanked the Chinese Government for their kind contributions towards the socio-economic development of the Maldives. He further noted that the construction of critical infrastructure such as hospitals, will have a significant impact to the daily lives of the Maldivian people.

en.title: State Minister Ahmed Khaleel calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea
en.description: State Minister Ahmed Khaleel calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea
en.body:
State Minister Ahmed Khaleel calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea

The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, H.E Ahmed Khaleel paid a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea, H.E Park Jin yesterday, as part of his ongoing Official Visit to the Republic of Korea.

During the meeting, State Minister Khaleel and Minister Park Jin discussed various ways to promote bilateral relations between the two countries, including trade, investment, and cultural exchanges. They further discussed the possibility of increasing tourist traffic between the two countries as well.

State Minister Khaleel expressed his admiration for the Republic of Korea’s rich cultural heritage and its advanced technological developments. He also highlighted the potential for further cooperation between the two countries in the field of renewable energy, health care, and education.

Minister Park Jin commended the efforts made by the Maldives to develop its tourism industry and expressed his government's readiness to further enhance the tourism sector through Korean investments and expertise. He also expressed his country's keen interest in increasing cultural exchanges between the two countries.

State Minister Khaleel expressed his appreciation for the warm welcome and hospitality extended to him during his visit to the Republic of Korea and expressed his hope that this meeting would lead to further cooperation and strengthened bilateral relations between the two countries.

The meeting between State Minister Khaleel and the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Korea His Excellency Park Jin is a significant step towards promoting mutual understanding and cooperation between the Maldives and the Republic of Korea.

The meeting was held on the sidelines of the Second Summit for Democracy held in the Republic of Korea. The Indo-Pacific Regional Meeting of the Second Summit for Democracy was convened by the Government of the Republic of Korea, under the theme of “Challenges and Progress in Addressing Corruption”. The Republic of Korea is one of the five co-hosts for this year's summit, along with the United States, Costa Rica, the Netherlands, and Zambia.

en.title: Maldives and Japan to hold 4th Round of Policy Dialogue in April 2023
en.description: Maldives and Japan to hold 4th Round of Policy Dialogue in April 2023
en.body:
Maldives and Japan to hold 4th Round of Policy Dialogue in April 2023

The Government of Maldives and the Government of Japan is set to hold its 4th Round of Japan-Maldives Policy Dialogue on 4 April 2023, in Tokyo, Japan.

His Excellency Mr. Ahmed Khaleel, Minister of State for Foreign Affairs will lead the Maldives delegation, and the Japanese delegation will be led by Mr. Arima Yutaka, Director-General, Southeast and Southwest Asian Department at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan.

During the Policy Dialogue, the two countries will discuss ways to further strengthen existing bilateral ties, including on development and economic cooperation, cultural exchanges and regional cooperation. Both countries will also discuss issues of mutual concern and shared interests in the regional and international sphere.

The Policy Dialogue, which was first held in 2018, has become an important mechanism for the two countries to strengthen their bilateral relationship. The previous rounds of the Policy Dialogue have covered a wide range of issues, including trade and investment, tourism, climate change, maritime security, and people-to-people exchanges.

Maldives and Japan regularly hold bilateral discussions to explore avenues for future cooperation, to exchange ideas and to deliberate on economic cooperation. The last policy dialogue between the two countries were held virtually on 04 March 2021.

en.title: The Maldives welcomes the adoption of the UN General Assembly Resolution “Request for an advisory opinion of the International Court of Justice on the obligations of States in respect of climate change”
en.description: The Maldives welcomes the adoption of the UN General Assembly Resolution
en.body:
The Maldives welcomes the adoption of the UN General Assembly Resolution

The Government of Maldives congratulates the Prime Minister of Vanuatu, Ishmael Kalsakau, the Government of Vanuatu as well as members of the core group for their initiative towards the historic adoption of a consensus Resolution on “Request for an advisory opinion of the International Court of Justice on the obligations of States in respect of climate change”. The Maldives is among the 132 co-sponsors of the Resolution.

The Resolution presents a defining moment for multilateralism and climate action. The consequent advisory opinion from the International Court of Justice will provide better understanding and much-needed clarification of the legal implications of climate change under international law on existing international legal obligations. Such an advisory opinion would assist the General Assembly, the United Nations and its Member States to take bolder and stronger climate action. It is also an important step in the fight for climate justice, especially for climate-vulnerable countries and Small Island Developing States.

The Maldives has continuously been a strong supporter of international initiatives that contributes towards the fight against climate change. The Government of Maldives reiterates its strong support towards more ambitious climate action - a strong pillar of its foreign policy.

en.title: State Minister Khaleel participates in the Indo-Pacific Regional Meeting of the Summit for Democracy 2023
en.description: State Minister Khaleel participates in the Indo-Pacific Regional Meeting of the Summit for Democracy 2023
en.body:
State Minister Khaleel participates in the Indo-Pacific Regional Meeting of the Summit for Democracy 2023

Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Ahmed Khaleel participated today in the Indo-Pacific Regional Meeting of the Summit for Democracy 2023, convened by the Government of the Republic of Korea, under the theme of Challenges and Progress in Addressing Corruption.

During this meeting, State Minister Khaleel delivered the country statement and reiterated Maldives’ unwavering commitment to the fight against corruption. State Minister Khaleel stressed how corruption erodes public trust, undermines the rule of law, and hinders economic progress and emphasized on the need for international cooperation in combatting corruption.

In his statement, State Minister Khaleel also reflected on the Government’s multi-faceted efforts towards tackling corruption – by strengthening the legal and institutional frameworks, promoting transparency, and encouraging public participation within the Maldives and by building partnerships with the international community to share best practices and lessons learned.

Hosted by the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea, Park Jin, the meeting was also attended by Foreign Ministers from the region. State Minister Khaleel was accompanied by Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Adam Hamid.

The Indo-Pacific Regional Meeting is part of the Second Summit for Democracy and it provided an opportunity for representatives from governments, international organizations, civil society and the private sector for dialogue and discussions on advancing the shared vision of addressing corruption in the region to create a more peaceful and prosperous future for all.

en.description: Minister Shahid holds a telephone call with Minister of Foreign Affairs of Georgia

Minister Shahid holds a telephone call with Minister of Foreign Affairs of Georgia

en.title: Minister Shahid holds a telephone call with the Prime Minister of Serbia
en.description: Minister Shahid holds a telephone call with the Prime Minister of Serbia

Minister Shahid holds a telephone call with the Prime Minister of Serbia

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid held a telephone call with the Prime Minister of the Republic of Serbia H.E. Ana Brnabić, today.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day Greetings to Bangladesh
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day Greetings to Bangladesh
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day Greetings to Bangladesh

Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sent a message of felicitations to His Excellency Dr. A. K. Abdul Momen, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh, on the occasion of the Independence Day of Bangladesh.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“As the Government and people of Bangladesh celebrate its fifty-second Independence Day, I wish to convey warm greetings and best wishes to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Bangladesh, on the joyous occasion of your Independence Day.

In September, the Maldives and Bangladesh will celebrate forty-five years of diplomatic relations. I am pleased to see that Maldives-Bangladesh relations have reached new heights in light of recent high-level engagements. I assure you that we are committed to deepening our longstanding ties of friendship and cooperation between the Maldives and Bangladesh.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration”.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Foreign Minister of Greece

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Pakistan Day greetings to Pakistan

en.title: State Minister Khaleel meets with the Presidential Special Envoy of the Republic of Korea
en.description: State Minister Khaleel meets with the Presidential Special Envoy of the Republic of Korea
en.body:
State Minister Khaleel meets with the Presidential Special Envoy of the Republic of Korea

Minister of State for Foreign Affairs His Excellency Ahmed Khaleel, met with the Presidential Special Envoy of the Republic of Korea, His Excellency Lee Jin-bok today. The Presidential Special Envoy is currently undertaking an Official Visit to the Maldives from 21 -22 March 2023.

At the meeting held this morning at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, State Minister Khaleel welcomed the Presidential Special Envoy to the Maldives and noted that this visit would serve to further strengthen the bilateral relations between the Maldives and the Republic of Korea.

During the meeting, State Minister Khaleel and Presidential Special Envoy Lee Jin-bok discussed ways to further strengthen the relations between the two countries in areas of mutual interest. State Minister Khaleel expressed his appreciation for the generous contributions of the Government of the Republic of Korea, including through agencies such as the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA), to the development of the Maldives.

Both State Minister and Presidential Special Envoy also reaffirmed their commitment to continued cooperation in areas such as tourism, education, and economic development and collaboration in advancing interests on areas of mutual concern, both bilaterally and internationally.

The Presidential Special Envoy was accompanied by the Ambassador of the Republic of Korea to the Maldives, His Excellency Woonjin Jeong, and other senior officials from the Government of the Republic of Korea. During the visit, the Presidential Special Envoy is scheduled to pay a courtesy call on Vice President, His Excellency Faisal Naseem. The Maldives and the Republic of Korea are also due to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on tourism cooperation, during the visit.

State Minister Khaleel was accompanied to the meeting by Foreign Secretary, Ahmed Latheef, Secretary (Economic Cooperation), Dr. Hussain Niyaz, Additional Secretary, Mr. Amin Javed Faizal, Joint Secretary, Ms. Mariyam Midhfa Naeem, Assistant Director, Ms. Khadeejath Nizwee Rasheed and Assistant Director, Mr. Ibrahim Haail.

en.title: Regional Director of UNOPS pays a courtesy call on Minister of State for Foreign Affairs

Regional Director of UNOPS pays a courtesy call on Minister of State for Foreign Affairs.

The Regional Director briefed the State Minister on the ongoing projects and the areas for future collaboration. State Minister Khaleel acknowledged the ongoing work by UNOPS in the Maldives, especially the infrastructure support to enhance water security and climate resiliency across the country, and the close collaboration of UNOPS and the Government of Maldives to map areas of intervention in the critical areas of health, waste, energy, marine resources, and climate change.

State Minister expressed hope that the presence of a UNOPS mission in the Maldives would be instrumental and a major steppingstone in the implementation of the much-needed development projects in the country.

en.title: Defence Secretary of India calls on Minister of State for Foreign Affairs
en.description: Defence Secretary of India calls on Minister of State for Foreign Affairs
en.body:
Defence Secretary of India calls on Minister of State for Foreign Affairs

Defence Secretary of India, Shri Giridhar Aramane, called on the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Ahmed Khaleel today. The meeting was held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

The State Minister welcomed Defence Secretary to the Maldives and reviewed the significant initiatives undertaken in defence cooperation of the two countries. State Minister thanked Defence Secretary for the tremendous contribution of India in bolstering security and defence capacities of the Maldives National Defence Force. State Minister further emphasized on the importance of solidifying joint efforts in addressing the common security challenges to ensure peace and stability in Indian Ocean region. Both State Minister and Defence Secretary discussed on further avenues to consolidate the defence ties of two countries.

The Defence Secretary of India is on a two-day Official Visit to the Maldives to hold the 4th Maldives-India Defence Cooperation Dialogue.

en.title: Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid calls for unity and the rejection of hate at the 49th Council of Foreign Ministers meeting of the OIC
en.description: Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid calls for unity and the rejection of hate at the 49th Council of Foreign Ministers meeting of the OIC
en.body:
Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid calls for unity and the rejection of hate at the 49th Council of Foreign Ministers meeting of the OIC

The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid, delivered remarks at the 49th Council of Ministers Meeting of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation being held today in Nouakchott, Mauritania.

In his remarks, Minister Shahid offered condolences to the people of Türkiye and Syria on behalf of the Maldivian people following the devastating earthquake that has affected both countries. He called on the international community to accelerate relief efforts and assistance.

He also noted that hateful acts such as the recent acts of burning and desecration of the Noble Quran will only strengthen the Islamic Ummah’s resolve against hate and extremism. He further called on the OIC to recognize the threat of climate change as one that requires urgent action.

Expressing solidarity with Muslims across the world, Minister Shahid also reaffirmed Maldives’ strong commitment to the Palestinian people, in securing their inalienable right to statehood. He reiterated Maldives’ call for the establishment of a sovereign and independent State of Palestine, based on the pre-1967 borders, with East Jerusalem as its capital. He also called for support and solidarity with the Rohingya Muslims in their struggle to live a life dignity that is free of fear.

en.title: Fourth Joint Meeting Mechanism to Deal with the Issue of Safety of Chinese Tourists in Maldives
en.description: Fourth Joint Meeting Mechanism to Deal with the Issue of Safety of Chinese Tourists in Maldive
en.body:
Fourth Joint Meeting Mechanism to Deal with the Issue of Safety of Chinese Tourists in Maldive

The Fourth Joint Meeting Mechanism to deal with the issue of safety of Chinese Tourists in the Maldives was held at the Manhattan Business Hotel today. Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, H.E. Mr. Ahmed Khaleel and Ambassador of the People’s Republic of China in Maldives, H.E. Ms. Wang Lixin co-chaired the Joint Meeting. Minister of State for Tourism, H.E. Mr. Ibrahim Rasheed Aboobakuru also attended the meeting.

As a follow-up on the Memorandum of Understanding concluded between the two Governments during the visit of His Excellency President Xi Jinping to the Maldives in September 2014, the Joint Meeting was held to discuss on the issue of safety of Chinese tourists in the Maldives.

In his opening remarks, State Minister Khaleel highlighted the commitment of the Government of Maldives to focus on making improvements to and maintaining a safe environment for all tourists, including Chinese visitors. He also noted the importance of such a platform to identify the challenges faced by Chinese tourists, and emphasised on the need to further strengthen communication and coordination between stakeholders regarding the safety of Chinese tourists in Maldives. State Minister further noted the positive results of closer coordination between the Maldives and China.

The Ambassador thanked the Government of Maldives for the coordination and cooperation extended in ensuring a safe environment to the Chinese tourists in the Maldives. Ambassador assured that this mechanism will strengthen the joint efforts by the Maldives and China in securing a safe environment to the Chinese tourists in Maldives.

The Joint Meeting was attended by senior officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Embassy of China in Maldives, Ministry of Tourism, Ministry of Health, Maldives Immigration, Maldives Customs Service, Maldives Police Service, MNDF, Maldives Airports Company Ltd. MATI and other key stakeholders.

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid calls for greater intra-Commonwealth support at the Commonwealth Foreign Affairs Ministers Meeting
en.description: Foreign Minister Shahid calls for greater intra-Commonwealth support at the Commonwealth Foreign Affairs Ministers Meeting
en.body:
Foreign Minister Shahid calls for greater intra-Commonwealth support at the Commonwealth Foreign Affairs Ministers Meeting

The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid, today participated in the 22nd Commonwealth Foreign Affairs Ministers Meeting (CFAMM) held at Marlborough House, London. The Commonwealth Foreign Affairs Ministers Meeting brought together Foreign Ministers from across the Commonwealth to deliberate on and hold an interactive discussion on three topics: “Building Resilience for Peaceful, Just and Stable Societies”, Financing for Climate-Resilient and Sustainable Development”, and “Leveraging Intra-Commonwealth Trade and Digital Connectivity”.

At the start of deliberations, Minister Shahid took the opportunity to offer condolences on the passing of Her late Majesty Queen Elizabeth II, Vice President of The Gambia Badara Alieu Joof, and the Foreign Minister of Ghana, Michael Moussa Adamo. He also expressed confidence in His Majesty King Charles III’s commitment to further strengthening the Commonwealth.

Minister Shahid called for strengthened support within the Commonwealth towards areas including good governance, rule of law, stability, economic recovery and relieving debt burdens. He further stressed the need to finalize the Multidimensional Vulnerability Index (MVI) and called on the Commonwealth to push International Financial Institutions to adopt the MVI. On climate change and environmental protection, Minister Shahid acknowledged the role played by the various Commonwealth mechanisms in place to support its Member States, including the Commonwealth Living Lands Charter, Commonwealth Blue Charter and the Commonwealth Climate Finance Access Hub. He also called for the operationalization of the Loss and Damage Fund in the lead up to COP28.

Minister Shahid also met and interacted with a number of Commonwealth Foreign Ministers on the sidelines of the meeting.

Minister Shahid was accompanied by the Foreign Secretary, Ahmed Latheef, High Commissioner of the Republic of Maldives to the United Kingdom, Dr. Farahanaz Faizal, Joint Secretary at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Mariyam Midhfa Naeem, Counsellor at the High Commission of the Republic of Maldives to the United Kingdom, Moosa Yameen Shahid, and Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Salman Zaki.

Australian High Commissioner to the Maldives calls on Minister of State for Foreign Affairs

During the meeting held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, State Minister Khaleel and High Commissioner Stephens reflected on the enhanced engagements between the two countries and discussed ways to further strengthen the historic bonds of friendship and cooperation especially in the fields of education, defence and security.

State Minister Khaleel and High Commissioner Stephens further expressed their commitment to increase cooperation on issues of mutual importance in the multilateral arena.

State Minister Khaleel was accompanied by Joint Secretary Shiuneen Rasheed, and Desk Officer Saifulla Waleed.

en.title: Maldives and Ghana Sign two Key Agreements aimed at Enhancing Bilateral Cooperation
en.description: Maldives and Ghana Sign two Key Agreements aimed at Enhancing Bilateral Cooperation
en.body:
Maldives and Ghana Sign two Key Agreements aimed at Enhancing Bilateral Cooperation

The Government of Maldives and the Government of Ghana have signed two key Agreements today that will further deepen the bilateral relationship between the two countries.

Following their meeting in London at the sidelines of the Commonwealth Foreign Affairs Ministers Meeting in London, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid signed the agreements on behalf of the Government of Maldives and the Minister for Foreign Affairs and Regional Integration of the Republic of Ghana, Her Excellency Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey signed the agreements on behalf of the Government of Ghana. The signing ceremony was held at the Marlborough House in London.

The two agreements signed between the Maldives and Ghana were:

1. Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Republic of Ghana on Mutual Exemption of Visa Requirements for their Respective Nationals.
2. Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Regional Integration of the Republic of Ghana on Political Consultation.

The conclusion of the agreements today is a step towards closer bilateral exchange between Ghana and Maldives through periodic consultations between the Ministries of Foreign Affairs of both countries and increased people-to-people contact facilitated through mutual exemption of visa.

Maldives established diplomatic relations with Ghana on 10 August 1989.

en.title: Secretary, Bilateral, Dr Hala Hameed delivers remarks at a special assembly held in Hamad bin Khalifa al Thani School, in Gan, Laamu Atoll to commemorate Commonwealth Day
en.description: Secretary, Bilateral, Dr Hala Hameed delivers remarks
en.body:
Secretary, Bilateral, Dr Hala Hameed delivers remarks

The Secretary, Bilateral, Dr Hala Hameed, today delivered remarks at a special assembly held in Hamad bin Khalifa al Thani School, in the island of Gan in Laamu Atoll to commemorate Commonwealth Day. During the special assembly, a school student hoisted the Commonwealth Flag for Peace to mark the 10th anniversary of the signing of the Commonwealth Charter.

In her remarks, she noted how proud Maldives is to rejoin the Commonwealth, an organization that embraces the rich diversity, friendship, democratic values and sustainable development. She further highlighted the key benefits of Commonwealth membership, including capacity building opportunities and being a voice for Small Island Developing States on issues such as climate change.

The school will also host a walk to mark the Commonwealth Day this evening. For the Commonwealth Day celebrations, Secretary, Bilateral, Dr Hala Hameed is accompanied by Joint Secretary Khadheeja Najeeha and Chief General Service Officer Aishath Rifga Mohamed.

Commonwealth Day is celebrated every year on the second Monday of March. The Commonwealth Flag for Peace initiative was launched by the Commonwealth to mark the 10th anniversary of the signing of the Commonwealth Charter by Her late Majesty Queen Elizabeth II. Maldives rejoined Commonwealth on 1 February 2020.

ސަޢޫދީ ޢަރަބިއްޔާ އާއި އީރާނާއި ދެމެދު ސިޔާސީ ގުޅުން ޤާއިމު ކުރުމާ ގުޅޭ ގޮތުން ސަޢޫދީ ޢަރަބިއްޔާ އާއި އީރާނާއި ޗައިނާއިން ނެރެފައިވާ ގުޅިފައިވާ ބަޔާނަށް ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރުން މަރުޙަބާ ކިޔުން

ސަޢޫދީ ޢަރަބިއްޔާ އާއި އީރާނުން ދެޤައުމުގެ މެދުގައި އަލުން ސިޔާސީ ގުޅުން ޤާއިމުކޮށް ދެޤައުމުގެ އެމްބަސީތައް އަލުން ހުޅުވުމަށާއި ޤައުމުތަކުގެ ސިޔާދަތަށް ޙުރުމަތްތެރިކޮށް ހިތުމާއި، ޤައުމުތަކުގެ ދާޚިލީ ކަންކަމާ ނުބެހުމާ ގުޅޭ އަސާސް އަލުން ކަށަވަރުކޮށް ސަޢޫދީ ޢަރަބިއްޔާ އާއި އީރާނާއި ޗައިނާއިން ނެރެފައިވާ ގުޅިފައިވާ ބަޔާނަށް ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރުން މަރުޙަބާ ކިޔަމެވެ.

އަދި މިހެޔޮ ބަދަލުތަކުގެ އަލީގައި ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރުން އީރާނާއެކު އަލުން ސިޔާސީ ގުޅުން ޤާއިމުކުރުމަށް ނިންމައިފީމެވެ.

en.title: Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid calls for greater global attention to the challenges faced by small states at the Berlin Economic Forum 2023
en.description: Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid calls for greater global attention to the challenges faced by small states at the Berlin Economic Forum 2023
en.body:
Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid calls for greater global attention to the challenges faced by small states at the Berlin Economic Forum 2023

The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid, today delivered a keynote address on "Economic Recovery and Challenges faced by Small States" at the Berlin Economic Forum 2023. The Forum was organized by Academy for Cultural Diplomacy.

In his remarks, Minister Shahid stated that small states among the worst affected by the current global economic crisis. He then shared three recommended courses of action that the international community could adopt to address the challenges of small states. Firstly, Minister Shahid recommended to assist small states by providing targeted solutions to existing problems, including climate change. Secondly, he recommended the international community to become more innovative with alternative measures. He called for international financial institutions to consider an alternative to GDP when considering concessional financing. He called for the finalization of the Multidimensional Vulnerability Index (MVI) and its implementation. Thirdly, Minister Shahid recommended that the international community listen to small states to find solutions for collective problems. He said that the voices of small states need to be heard, especially in the international financial system. He concluded by emphasizing on the need for better collaboration to create a multilateral system that is more equitable, just and fair.

The Berlin Economic forum was held in the margins of the Berlin International Tourism Trade Fair (ITB) from 6-10 March 2023. Minister Shahid is accompanying the President of the Republic of Maldives, Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, on an Official Visit to Germany.

en.title: Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Italy presents Letter of Credence to the President of Italy
en.description: Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Italy presents Letter of Credence to the President of Italy
en.body:
Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Italy presents Letter of Credence to the President of Italy

His Excellency Dr. Asim Ahmed presented his Letter of Credence to His Excellency Mr. Sergio Mattarella, President of the Italian Republic, as the Non-Resident Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the Republic of Maldives to the Republic of Italy at a ceremony held at the Quirinale Palace in Rome, Italy today.

During the ceremony, Ambassador Asim Ahmed conveyed greetings from His Excellency, President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih and the people of Maldives to the President, and the People of Italy. Ambassador Asim further expressed commitment to work closely with the Government of Italy during his tenure with a renewed focus on enhancing bilateral and multilateral cooperation between the two countries.

During his visit to Italy, Ambassador Asim Ahmed met with officials from the Italian government and discussed ways to further strengthen the traditional, close and friendly relations between the two countries.

Ambassador Asim was accompanied by Mr. Hassan Hussain Shihab, Counsellor at the Permanent Mission of the Republic of Maldives to the United Nations and other International Organizations at Geneva.

en.title: Minister Shahid meets with Minister of State at the Federal Foreign Office of Germany
en.description: Minister Shahid meets with Minister of State at the Federal Foreign Office of Germany
en.body:
Minister Shahid meets with Minister of State at the Federal Foreign Office of Germany

Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid has met with Vice Minister, Minister of State at the Federal Foreign Office of Germany, Dr. Tobias Lindner, this afternoon.

During a meeting held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Germany, Minister Shahid and Vice-Minister Lindner discussed the growing partnership between the Maldives and Germany, especially in the areas of tourism, trade and economic cooperation, and environment and climate change. Minister Shahid expressed appreciation to the Government of Germany for the continuous contributions made towards the socio-economic development of the Maldives and highlighted the importance of sustaining the momentum of the partnership.

During the meeting, Foreign Minister Shahid also acknowledged the role played by Germany in the European Union and highlighted the pivotal role played by the European Union in reviving democracy in the Maldives. Minister Shahid and Vice-Minister Lindner reiterated the commitment of both countries to continue working closely together, bilaterally and in the international fora, on issues of mutual interest.

Minister Shahid was accompanied by the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Ahmed Khaleel, Ambassador of the Republic of Maldives to the Federal Republic of Germany, Her Excellency Aishath Shan Shakir, Joint Secretary Ms. Shiuneen Rasheed and Counsellor at the Embassy of Maldives in Berlin, Ms. Umaira Mohamed.

Minister Abdulla Shahid is currently accompanying His Excellency President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih on an Official Visit to Germany.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Ghana
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Ghana
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Ghana

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to Her Excellency Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey, Minister of Foreign Affairs and Regional Integration of the Republic of Ghana.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

On the joyous occasion of the Independence Day of the Republic of Ghana, I wish to extend warm greetings and best wishes to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of Ghana.

Let me take this opportunity to express my best wishes for the peace and prosperity of Ghana, and my earnest hope that the cordial relations between our two countries will strengthen in the years ahead.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.

en.title: Government of Maldives dispatches humanitarian aid to Türkiye
en.description: Government of Maldives dispatches humanitarian aid to Türkiye
en.body:
Government of Maldives dispatches humanitarian aid to Türkiye

The Government of Maldives has dispatched the first batch of the 500,000 cans of tuna to Türkiye as humanitarian aid, today.

This is following a decision made by His Excellency Ibrahim Mohamed Solih on 10 February 2023 to extend humanitarian and relief aid to the distressed people of Türkiye after the devastating earthquake that hit the region on 6 February 2023.

On behalf of the Government of Maldives, the humanitarian aid was handed over by Foreign Secretary, Mr. Ahmed Latheef. The aid was seen off from Velana International Airport to the Republic of Türkiye by officials from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Honorary Consulate of the Republic of Türkiye in Maldives.

The aid is being airlifted by Turkish Airlines in 5 batches and is expected to be completed by 10th March 2023.

en.title: Foreign Secretary delivers statement at the Summit-level Meeting of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) Contact Group in response to COVID-19 on post-pandemic global recovery.
en.description: Foreign Secretary delivers statement at the Summit-level Meeting of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM)
en.body:
Foreign Secretary delivers statement at the Summit-level Meeting of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM)

Foreign Secretary, Ahmed Latheef, delivered a statement at the Summit-level Meeting of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) Contact Group in response to COVID-19 on post-pandemic global recovery today held in Baku, Azerbaijan.

In his statement, Foreign Secretary Latheef highlighted the recovery efforts by the Government of Maldives during COVID-19 pandemic including the initiative of the Government of Maldives to provide free vaccination to the vaccine-eligible population. Foreign Secretary Latheef also expressed those conflicts across the world has generated new challenges for smaller countries. Foreign Secretary called on the international community to provide financing options to developing countries especially Small Island Developing States (SIDS). Foreign Secretary concluded his remarks by commending NAM for their efforts during the COVID-19 pandemic and Member States of NAM to be resilient and unit to combat new and emerging threats.

Foreign Secretary Latheef was accompanied by Joint Secretary at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Mariyam Midhfa Naeem, and Assistant Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Khadeejath Nizwee Rasheed.

The Non-Aligned Movement comprises of 120 Member States and is one of the largest international organizations after the United Nations. The Maldives joined NAM on 15 August 1976 and has been an active member in the organization.

en.title: Minister Shahid Participates at the Panel Discussion at the Raisina Dialogue 2023
en.description: Minister Shahid Participates at the Panel Discussion at the Raisina Dialogue 202
en.body:
Minister Shahid Participates at the Panel Discussion at the Raisina Dialogue 202

Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives Abdulla Shahid joins as a panelist at the panel discussion themed ‘Heart of the Matter: LiFE (Lifestyle for environment) for our Common Future’ held as part of the 8th edition of the Raisina Dialogue 2023, from 2-4 March 2023.

Minister Shahid discussed the vulnerability of Maldives and other Small Island Developing States and highlighted the role India’s Presidency of G20 can play in bringing the voice of vulnerable states to the center of discussion. Minister Shahid also highlighted Prime Minister Modi’s theme for G20 and thanked him for inclusivity and bringing the issue of climate change on to the agenda. Minister Shahid also stressed on the importance of access to predictable, adequate and sustainable climate finance for developing countries.

Joining him at the panel were, Minister of Foreign Affairs and External Trade of Bhutan, Tandi Dorji, G20 Sherpa of India Amitabh Kant, Vice President, Environment, Policy and Social Initiatives of Apple Inc., USA, Lisa Jackson and CEO of Bisleri, India, Angelo George. The panel was moderated by CEO of Children's Investment Fund Foundation, UK, Kate Hampton.

The Raisina Dialogue is a multilateral conference held annually in New Delhi, India. The conference addresses the most challenging issues facing the global community. Minister Shahid is on a three-day official visit to India, to attend the 8th edition of the Raisina Dialogue 2023 organised by the Observer Research Foundation and the Ministry of External Affairs of India.

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid meets with the External Affairs Minister of India
en.description: Foreign Minister Shahid meets with the External Affairs Minister of India
